nodes.label: Content Security Policy (CSP)
nodes.rationale: CSP restricts external resources to only what the app needs (unpkg.com for Leaflet, cdnjs.cloudflare.com for html2canvas, Google Fonts domains, OpenStreetMap tile domains, and the Supabase endpoint via connect-src). Blocks inline scripts, other-origin scripts, objects and iframes. 'unsafe-inline' is kept only for style-src because Leaflet applies inline styles via JS. frame-ancestors (anti-clickjacking) cannot be set via <meta>, so on GitHub Pages (no custom HTTP headers available) that protection is limited.

nodes.label: HTTPS Enforcement (httpsRedirect.js)
nodes.rationale: HTTPS redirect is implemented as an external script file rather than inline specifically so the CSP's script-src does not need to allow 'unsafe-inline'.

nodes.label: N-Layer Architecture (Security → Data → Business → Presentation)
nodes.rationale: Scripts are loaded in a strict dependency order: security utilities first because other modules depend on Security.escapeHTML, then data-layer modules, then business-layer services, then presentation-layer renderers/controllers.

nodes.label: Referrer Policy (strict-origin-when-cross-origin)
nodes.rationale: Avoids sending the full URL to external sites when a user clicks an outbound link, limiting referrer leakage.

nodes.label: Subresource Integrity (SRI)
nodes.rationale: Integrity hashes on the Leaflet CSS/JS and html2canvas CDN assets make the browser reject the file if the CDN-served content is altered or tampered with.
